name: Compile qc data from tractmeasures (tsv) data
summary: Concatenates DSI Studio QC tractmeasure tsv files from many subjects into one tsv with subject, session and tag columns using pandas; a group-analysis utility.
description: Reads every input tractmeasure tsv, stacks them into one table and adds subjectID, sessionID and tags columns from the brainlife input metadata. Use it to gather per-subject DSI Studio QC tables into a single file for downstream statistics; it does no computation on the values.

inputs.description: DSI Studio QC tractmeasure tsv files of several subjects (one per input).

outputs.description: Single tsv (tractmeasure.tsv) with all input rows plus subjectID, sessionID and tags columns.
